plain: A person who owns land outright

webster.text: One who owns an estate in fee-simple, fee-tail or for life; the possessor of a freehold.

example.quote: If so, every freeholder having a right to vote for the President, by the interposition of electors, will attend to his interests.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 18, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
